name: Let My Torments Be Yours

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

disable: DC 32 Thievery check (master) to carefully remove the Vile Remnant from the skeleton's ribcage without triggering the haunt or DC 35 Religion check (expert) to exorcise the haunt

items.name: A Gift of Torment
items.text:
Trigger A creature attacks the skeleton or ends their turn adjacent to the remains

---
Effect The skeleton lurches to unlife just long enough to beg for peace, then exhales at the triggering creature, who must attempt a DC 33 Will save save or be subjected to the haunt's curse. A cursed creature becomes racked with pain from what feels like hours spent under a torturer's knives and takes a –1 status penalty to Fortitude saves. In addition, each time the creature takes slashing or piercing damage, they must succeed at a DC 33 Fortitude save save or become Sickened 1 from the agony (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). The curse remains until removed by Cleanse Affliction or similar magic.

text: The skeleton suddenly appears to lurch forward, crying out in pain as a shaking voice begs for someone to take away the pain.
